[Unit]

[Service]

ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 @FIXTURE@/libexec/orbit-instance-bridge

[Install]

systemd/orbit-instance-dev-ports.service.text:
[Unit]
Description=Orbit Instance containers: agent development ports to Caddy
DefaultDependencies=no
After=local-fs.target nftables.service
Before=network-pre.target wg-quick@orbit.service docker.service incus.service
Wants=network-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/nft --file @FIXTURE@/dev-ports.nft
ExecReload=/usr/sbin/nft --file @FIXTURE@/dev-ports.nft
ExecStop=/usr/sbin/nft delete table inet orbit_instance_dev_ports

[Install]
WantedBy=sysinit.target

systemd/orbit-instance-egress-table.serv.text:
[Unit]
Description=Orbit Instance egress proxy: its nftables table
DefaultDependencies=no
After=local-fs.target nftables.service
Before=network-pre.target wg-quick@orbit.service docker.service incus.service orbit-instance-egress.service
Wants=network-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/nft --file @FIXTURE@/egress/egress.nft
ExecReload=/usr/sbin/nft --file @FIXTURE@/egress/egress.nft
ExecStop=/usr/sbin/nft delete table inet orbit_instance_egress

[Install]
WantedBy=sysinit.target

systemd/orbit-instance-egress.service.text:
[Unit]
Description=Orbit Instance egress proxy
After=network-online.target incus.service orbit-instance-egress-table.service
Wants=network-online.target
BindsTo=orbit-instance-egress-table.service

[Service]
User=proxy
Group=proxy
ExecStartPre=+/usr/sbin/nft list table inet orbit_instance_egress
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/squid -N -d 1 -f @FIXTURE@/egress/orbit-instance-egress.conf
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectKernelLogs=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectClock=true
ProtectHostname=true
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX AF_NETLINK
RestrictNamespaces=true
RestrictRealtime=true
LockPersonality=true
SystemCallArchitectures=native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

systemd/orbit-instance-wake.path.text:
[Unit]
Description=Orbit Instance containers: wake requests

[Path]
PathExistsGlob=/dev/shm/orbit/hibernation/app-instance-*.wake
Unit=orbit-instance-wake.service

[Install]
WantedBy=paths.target

systemd/orbit-instance-wake.service.text:
[Unit]
Description=Orbit Instance containers: resume a frozen container on a wake request
# Several Instances may wake at once; the start limit must never switch the wake requests off.
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=@FIXTURE@/libexec/orbit-instance-wake
TimeoutStartSec=30
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateNetwork=no
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=-/dev/shm/orbit/hibernation -/data/caddy/orbit/hibernation /sys/fs/cgroup
RuntimeDirectory=orbit-instance-wake
Environment=INCUS_CONF=/run/orbit-instance-wake

calls.append:
["--project","orbit-instances","image","list","--format","json"]
["query","--","/1.0/instances?project=orbit-instances&recursion=1"]
["--project","orbit-instances","init","ubuntu-26.04-instance-stock","orbit-instance-build","--config","security.idmap.isolated=true","--device","eth0,ipv4.address=10.253.0.254"]
["query","--","/1.0/instances/orbit-instance-build?project=orbit-instances"]
["--project","orbit-instances","start","orbit-instance-build"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--","cloud-init","status","--wait"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","apt-get","update"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","apt-get","install","--yes","--no-install-recommends","--","acl","git","nftables"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","sh","-c","set -eu
touch /etc/cloud/cloud-init.disabled
if id ubuntu >/dev/null 2>&1; then userdel --remove ubuntu; fi
if getent group lxd >/dev/null 2>&1; then groupdel lxd; fi
groupadd --gid 2750 agent
useradd --uid 2750 --gid agent --create-home --shell /bin/bash agent
groupadd --gid 1000 orbit
useradd --uid 1000 --gid orbit --create-home --shell /bin/bash orbit
groupadd --gid 2760 work
usermod --append --groups work agent
usermod --append --groups work orbit
passwd --lock agent
passwd --lock orbit
chmod 0700 /home/agent
chmod 0750 /home/orbit
install -d -o agent -g agent -m 0700 /home/agent/.codex /home/agent/.config /home/agent/.config/orbit
find /etc/sudoers.d -mindepth 1 ! -name README -delete
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /etc/orbit
install -d -o agent -g work -m 2770 /srv/workspace
setfacl -m g:work:rwX -m d:u::rwX,d:g::rwX,d:g:work:rwX,d:o::--- /srv/workspace
install -d -o agent -g work -m 2770 /var/lib/orbit/vite-plus-home
setfacl -m g:work:rwX -m d:u::rwX,d:g::rwX,d:g:work:rwX,d:o::--- /var/lib/orbit/vite-plus-home
install -d -o agent -g work -m 2770 /var/lib/orbit/vite-plus-home/cache
for part in bin js_runtime node_modules recipe config.json; do
ln -s /opt/orbit-runtime/current/vite-plus-home/\$part /var/lib/orbit/vite-plus-home/\$part
done
echo 'proc /proc proc defaults,hidepid=invisible 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
"]
["file","push","--project","orbit-instances","--create-dirs","--uid","0","--gid","0","--mode","0640","-","orbit-instance-build/etc/nftables.conf"]
["file","push","--project","orbit-instances","--create-dirs","--uid","0","--gid","0","--mode","0644","@FIXTURE@/orbit-root-ca.crt","orbit-instance-build/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/orbit-managed-root-ca.crt"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","systemctl","enable","nftables.service","t3.service"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","update-ca-certificates"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","apt-get","clean"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","find","/var/lib/apt/lists","-mindepth","1","-delete"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","truncate","--size","0","/etc/machine-id"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","sh","-c","if [ -f /var/lib/dbus/machine-id ] && [ ! -L /var/lib/dbus/machine-id ]; then rm /var/lib/dbus/machine-id; fi"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","rm","-f","/etc/ld.so.cache"]
["exec","--project","orbit-instances","orbit-instance-build","--env","DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive","--","sh","-c","getent passwd ubuntu >/dev/null && echo user:ubuntu; for f in /etc/sudoers.d/*; do [ "$f" = /etc/sudoers.d/README ] || [ ! -e "$f" ] || echo "sudoers:$f"; done; getent group sudo admin | cut -d: -f4 | tr , '\n' | sed '/^$/d; s/^/member:/'; true"]
["--project","orbit-instances","stop","orbit-instance-build"]
["--project","orbit-instances","publish","orbit-instance-build","--alias","orbit-instance-aaaaaaaaaaaa","user.orbit.stock-build="]
["--project","orbit-instances","delete","--force","--","orbit-instance-build"]
["--project","orbit-instances","image","list","--format","json"]
["query","--request","POST","--data","{"name": "orbit-instance", "target": "c7e7d08a2d95c84bc1f078883e9ff4274e2af98dbb835e02548a5723a6bf1f2e"}","--","/1.0/images/aliases?project=orbit-instances"]
["query","--","/1.0/instances?all-projects=true&recursion=1"]
["query","--","/1.0/networks/orbitinst0?project=default"]
